messages:
Marta L: quick flag  Trial account 'NovaRetail' (trial-719) stalled day 8. activation events dropped to zero after they tried the CSV import. looks like they couldn't map product_sku column.
Jason T: do we have the import error? stack or user-facing?
Marta L: user error: popup said "Unable to parse sku" then no retry option. they DM'd to say they gave up.
Ibrahim H: I can patch the UI to allow a manual-mapping fallback and add clearer error text. estimate 2-3 hrs.
Lena P: thanks. let's do two-parallel tracks: engineering fix + immediate customer-facing rescue. propose: 1) enable manual mapping in-dashboard for this account only, 2) 20-min troubleshooting call with their ops lead, 3) offer 30% off first paid month if they convert in the next 14 days.
Marta L: sounds good. can you open a rescue ticket and owner?
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-4988 assigned to Lena P  "NovaRetail trial rescue: CSV mapping block + conversion incentive". Due: 2026-04-10
Jason T: Ibrahim please make the UI toggle per-customer and add audit log. also drop a migration note in the ticket for full release.
Ibrahim H: PR up: `git commit -m "csv-import: per-customer manual-map toggle + clearer parse errors"` Link: https://git.internal/r/2345
Marta L: scheduled call for Fri 9am ET. invite includes quick repro steps and a one-pager on import tips.
Lena P: adding a short neutral-script for CSMs if they ask about pricing: explain the 30% conversion credit, limits, and show downgrade options (see ticket).
Marta L: downgrade options? list so CSM is ready.
Lena P: bullets added to ticket-4988: - prorated downgrade to Starter tier for first billing cycle - maintain CSV export access for 90 days - 45-day winback coupon if they downgrade within 60 days.
Jason T: also add automated health-check in the trial workflow: if import fails twice -> flag CSM and create rescue ticket automatically. file a tiny infra task.
Ibrahim H: toggle enabled for trial-719 and monitored. logs show two failed import attempts earlier, now successful after manual mapping during the call.
Marta L: great outcome. I've moved account to "needs-confirmation" and set renewal-check in 30 days. Sampler ask: please paste post-call 3-line feedback in this thread.
Lena P: feedback collected: 1) import UI needs clearer guidance for sku formats, 2) retry button + sample file would help, 3) they liked the quick call and conversion credit.
Marta L: saved transcript to ticket-4988 and added a short item for product backlog: sample file + inline examples. thanks team. :partyparrot:
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-4988] status updated -> resolved (Lena P).
